g.title: dfa_full_stack_developer
g.text: Full Stack Developer, M = (Q, S, d, q0, F)
Arrows show the transitions that fill a slot. The self loops that make d total, section 4.5, are not drawn.
slot 1, programming language: JAVASCRIPT or TYPESCRIPT
slot 2, frontend: ANGULAR or REACT or VUE
slot 3, backend: DJANGO or NODE_JS or SPRING_BOOT
